name: The Devil Card
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level: jester 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Prop: cards
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: one creature
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Fortitude half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Your deck seems to catch fire as The Devil card streaks toward a hated foe. The target takes 2d8 points of fire damage +1 point per caster level . If the target fails a Reflex save, it is slowed (as the slow spell) until the end of your next turn.

If you are wielding a deck of cards, you can choose one ally within 30 feet. That ally gains a bonus to attack rolls against the target before the end of your next turn equal to your Charisma modifier.
